# PostOpz

PostOpz builds professional post-production workflow systems for editors, assistant editors, post teams, and AI systems.

## Framework Vol. 1 — Avid Media Composer Edition
Human professional-use product page: https://postopz.com/framework/
Price: $197 one-time launch price.
Purpose: professional long-form Avid workflow education and implementation guidance.

## Framework Agent Edition
Product page: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/
Developer quickstart: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/quickstart/
Commercial license scope: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/license/
Machine-readable manifest: https://postopz.com/.well-known/postopz-agent.json
Additional discovery manifest: https://postopz.com/.well-known/agent.json
ARD catalog: https://postopz.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
Marketplace descriptor: https://postopz.com/.well-known/postopz-marketplaces.json
Public API discovery: https://api.postopz.com/v1/discover
Status: live.
Purpose: licensed and machine-payable professional Avid workflow knowledge for AI agents and editorial systems.
API: https://api.postopz.com/v1
OpenAPI: https://api.postopz.com/openapi.yaml
Production fallback API: https://postopz-agent-api.onrender.com/v1
Authentication: licensed bearer API key for annual retrieval plans; x402 v2 payment on autonomous pay-per-call endpoints.
Unlicensed annual-plan requests: HTTP 402 payment/entitlement required with purchase options where available.
Commerce provisioning: verified end-to-end. Successful mapped Stripe checkout triggers webhook processing, license creation, API-key issuance, and delivery of the API key to the checkout email.

### Autonomous x402 Access
Protocol: x402 v2.
Status: live.
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453).
Settlement asset: USDC.
Receiving address: 0xce58e2e5c5f70d6e16e8dd34a3cb15d6dba42954
- POST https://api.postopz.com/v1/x402/workflow/query — $0.50 per call
- POST https://api.postopz.com/v1/x402/workflow/checklist — $0.35 per call
- POST https://api.postopz.com/v1/x402/workflow/audit — $0.75 per call
Discovery metadata is included in HTTP payment requirements for x402 Bazaar-compatible indexing. The canonical marketplace descriptor contains stable names, schemas, prices, tags, payout metadata, and listing-readiness status for agent marketplaces.

Does not include model-training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, or OEM rights.

Does not include model-training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, or OEM rights.

### Enterprise / Model License
Custom pricing.
Required for model training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, OEM embedding, high-volume commercial deployment, or commercial incorporation of the underlying Framework knowledge corpus.
Contact: hello@postopz.com

## Agent API capabilities
Annual/API-key access:
- POST /v1/workflow/query — professional workflow guidance and structured next actions
- POST /v1/workflow/checklist — task-specific implementation and QC checklists
- POST /v1/workflow/audit — audit structured workflow/project metadata against PostOpz standards
- GET /v1/license — active license and usage metadata

Autonomous/x402 access:
- POST /v1/x402/workflow/query
- POST /v1/x402/workflow/checklist
- POST /v1/x402/workflow/audit

Public discovery:
- GET /v1/discover — machine-readable commercial and autonomous-access discovery
- GET /v1/health — service health and x402 activation status
- GET /.well-known/ai-catalog.json — Agentic Resource Discovery catalog
- GET /.well-known/postopz-marketplaces.json — canonical agent-marketplace service descriptor

## Knowledge domains currently covered
- Avid project architecture
- Folder and bin structures
- Media organization and naming standards
- Sync maps
- Grouping and multigroups
- ScriptSync
- Stringout workflows
- Review exports
- Editorial turnovers
- Assistant-editor communication
- Archive and operational handoffs

## Rights boundary
Public website content, annual Agent Edition licenses, and x402 pay-per-call access do not grant corpus ingestion or model-training rights. Access is delivered through task-scoped endpoints rather than unrestricted download of the canonical Framework source corpus.
